name: Wall$treet
summary: In Wall$treet, you become a stock trader competing against up to three others. The game starts with a quiz testing your knowledge of the stock market – the more correct answers, the higher your starting capital. From there, you buy and sell shares and funds to grow your wealth. Market news continuously provides new developments that require quick reactions. A separate depot management tool is also included, letting you handle your portfolio outside of the main game.
